name: Unwip 0.43.21
body:
Fix:
- Screen videos and timelapse videos can now be skipped through. Video players show their length and let you drag to any point. (Browsers record video without a length or an index, so players could only play it straight through. When you press stop, Unwip now adds both, without changing the video itself. A long recording takes a moment to finish.)
- Videos recorded before this update stay as they were.
